Message.Name: Indication Of Interest Message
Message.Description: The Indication of Interest message disseminates an indication of interest for a given instrument to all participants

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: IOIUTPID
Field.Description: IOI identifier: uniqueness is guaranteed for the day for all instruments

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Optional, IOI price, to be calculated with PriceScaleCode

Field.Name: ValidityTime
Field.Description: Optional, indicates the IOI end of validity time (HHMMSS)

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all prices in the message

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: Indicates the Firm ID who issued the indication of interest if the IOI is not anonymous

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the IOI
